description: Five-digit Ohio county FIPS code.
transformation_or_rule: Exact source county identifier.

description: Ohio county name without the word County.
transformation_or_rule: Mapped from county_fips.

description: Employed residents (household concept, not payroll jobs), not seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Civilian labor force, not seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Number of BLS county source months used in the quarterly value.
transformation_or_rule: Three normally; two for the documented 2025Q4 partial quarter.

description: Whether the county quarterly value uses an incomplete source quarter.
transformation_or_rule: True for the documented 2025Q4 partial quarter.

description: Unemployed residents, not seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Unemployment rate
transformation_or_rule: 100 x cty_unemployed / cty_labor_force (not an average of monthly rates)

description: FHFA county House Price Index.
transformation_or_rule: Annual source value, indexed to 2000=100, repeated across Q1 through Q4.

description: ACS housing-unit estimate.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; missing in 2020 and 2025.

description: Margin of error for ACS housing units.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; source sentinel values become missing.

description: Margin of error for ACS median household income.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; source sentinel values become missing.

description: ACS median household income estimate.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; missing in 2020 and 2025.

description: CPI for All Urban Consumers, all items, seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Number of monthly CPI observations used in the quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: Whether the quarterly CPI value is based on an incomplete source period.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: Year-over-year CPI inflation
transformation_or_rule: 100 x (CPI_q / CPI_same_quarter_prior_year - 1)

description: Whether the quarterly year-over-year inflation value uses an incomplete source period.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: 30-year fixed mortgage average rate (Freddie Mac PMMS)
transformation_or_rule: Mean of weekly observations dated in the quarter; missing if fewer than 12

description: Number of weekly mortgage-rate observations used in the quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: 3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield
transformation_or_rule: Mean of daily values in the quarter; missing if fewer than 55 trading days

description: Number of daily 10-year Treasury observations used in the quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: 3-year Treasury constant-maturity yield; the team's low-risk return benchmark
transformation_or_rule: Mean of daily values in the quarter; missing if fewer than 55 trading days

description: Number of daily 3-year Treasury observations used in the quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: ACS total population estimate.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; missing in 2020 and 2025.

description: ZHVI divided by ACS median household income.
transformation_or_rule: Missing whenever either source value is missing.

description: ZHVI divided by twelve times monthly ZORI.
transformation_or_rule: Uses the quarter-end Zillow values.

description: Calendar quarter number.
transformation_or_rule: 1 through 4.

description: Last calendar day of the panel quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Used as the panel time label.

description: Ohio employed persons, seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Ohio civilian labor force, seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Number of Ohio state BLS source months used in the quarterly value.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: Whether the Ohio state quarterly value uses an incomplete source quarter.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across counties by design.

description: Ohio unemployed persons, seasonally adjusted
transformation_or_rule: Mean of available monthly values; needs at least 2 of 3 months

description: Ohio unemployment rate
transformation_or_rule: 100 x state_unemployed / state_labor_force

description: Vacant ACS units divided by total ACS housing units.
transformation_or_rule: 100 x vacant_housing_units / housing_units; repeated across all quarters of observed years.

description: ACS vacant-housing-unit estimate.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; missing in 2020 and 2025.

description: Margin of error for ACS vacant housing units.
transformation_or_rule: Repeated across all quarters of observed years; source sentinel values become missing.

description: Calendar year of the quarter.
transformation_or_rule: 2015 through 2025.

description: Three-year-ahead ZHVI growth.
transformation_or_rule: 100 x (zhvi_usd_t_plus_12 / zhvi_usd - 1).

description: Zillow Home Value Index at the quarter-end month.
transformation_or_rule: March, June, September, and December month-end observations.

description: ZHVI value twelve quarters after the current row.
transformation_or_rule: Within-county lead of 12 quarters.

description: Three-year-ahead ZORI growth.
transformation_or_rule: 100 x (zori_usd_month_t_plus_12 / zori_usd_month - 1).

description: Zillow Observed Rent Index at the quarter-end month.
transformation_or_rule: March, June, September, and December month-end observations.

description: ZORI value twelve quarters after the current row.
transformation_or_rule: Within-county lead of 12 quarters.
